entries.change: Added Delhi: petrol ₹102.12 a litre (26 Oct 2026) and CNG ₹86.98 a kg (IGL, from 29 Aug 2026); the DERC domestic tariff with surcharges, electricity tax and the Delhi Government's subsidy; and Delhi rooftop solar subsidies, generation-based incentive and output, from Tata Power-DDL's FY26 customer handbook. PPAC, the solar export rate, panel degradation and how long the generation incentive is paid are still to be verified.
Added the PPF rate (7.1%), deposit limits and term from the National Savings Institute, and the one-year holding period for equity, for the SIP vs PPF vs FD tool.
Added capital-gains rates (12.5% long-term, ₹1.25 lakh yearly exemption on equity gains, 20% short-term on equity) from PIB and CBDT, for the plot vs FD vs mutual funds tool.
Added income-tax slabs, standard deduction, rebate and cess for tax year 2026-27 (both regimes, under 60), from the Income Tax Department and CBDT, for the tax regime tool.
Set Lucknow CNG to ₹107.00 a kg (Green Gas Limited, from 3 Oct 2026) and Lucknow petrol to ₹101.86 a litre (19 Oct 2026).
Added UP stamp duty and registration for the rent vs buy tool, as a placeholder (not verified).
Added the UP domestic electricity tariff and rooftop solar subsidy, generation, degradation and export credit, as placeholders (not verified).
Set the default scenario table (inflation, equity return, home prices, rent, fuel and electricity prices) and the 9% default rate on the extra car price, as CapitalVerdict's working assumptions.
